title: CEDAR · The glow, explained wrong · II
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: The second explanation: the librarian says it's a lamp. Somebody lives up there and reads. The page draws a cabin with one window and a green lamp in it the size of the ridge, and a shelf of books whose spines are the town's names. Certain. Wrong. Warmer than the first.
